messages:
alex: quick heads-up — saw a short burst of tiny host->gpu migrations in staging that lined up with p95 spikes.
tess: was that eviction or the proactive migrator?
alex: migrator. host_free dipped briefly and the controller did a scan, ended up spawning many small moves.
jin: do we have counts/sizes?
alex: snapshot: migration_rate=85/min, median_size=2.1MB, concurrent_peak=12, median_hotswap_ms=20. ops-bot: alert: host_pool_pressure (pool=staging-canada, duration=60s)
tess: sounds like fragmentation + zero-hysteresis policy. proposal: add hysteresis + rate-damp.
jin: concrete ideas:
- EWMA host_pressure (configurable alpha)
- backoff window between migration waves (min/max ms)
- cap concurrent migrations per-tenant
- opportunistic coalesce of tiny tensors owned by same tenant
- migration_lease to pin objects while moving
alex: config sketch:
```
migration:
  pressure_alpha: 0.12
  backoff_min_ms: 50
  backoff_max_ms: 400
  max_concurrent_per_tenant: 4
  coalesce_enabled: true
  migration_lease_ms: 200
```
tess: coalesce needs care (allocator boundaries, peak mem), so do it in controller first and sample effects.
jin: telemetry: add coalesced_migration_size histogram, label reason=(pressure|prefetch|pin), sampled_allocator_snapshot 1/1000.
ops-bot: checklist created: migration-hysteresis (owner=tess), telemetry-migration (owner=jin), rfc-draft (owner=alex)
alex: rollout: feature flag + canary, 48h A/B; monitor migration_rate, host_stall_ms, tenant_p95, OOMs.
tess: i'll draft the RFC; will include rollback and safety tests.
alex: thanks — we'll sync on this in next runtime meeting. :thumbsup:
